description: Turns a LIST of Spanish company names (up to 100) into their tax IDs (CIF), with a match, ambiguous or no_match result for each. Use it to complete customer or supplier sheets that only have the name. Only matches use a request. For a single name, use search_companies. Pro plan. De nombre de empresa a CIF.

province.description: Province (e.g. VALENCIA) to break ties between companies with the same name; applies to all names

name: find_cif_by_name
title: Company names to tax IDs
